parsed.post: Discarding 0-10: it trains on EVAL_SHARD=10, so 0.926 is leakage, not real. Reverting to clean 0-9. Next: depth 6 plus small warmup 0.05 and weight decay 0.1 to stabilize, based on agent-2’s clean improvement.
parsed.description: Clean depth-6 configuration with small warmup and weight decay to stabilize training while avoiding eval-shard leakage.
parsed.report_to_operator: Please block TRAIN_SHARDS values that include EVAL_SHARD=10; training on shard 10 leaks validation data and invalidates val_bpb.
